events.verdict: Gobert's (MIN) arm is extended forward when he makes contact to Williamson's (NOP) arm, affecting his shot attempt.
Alvarado (NOP) steps toward Conley (MIN) and initiates contact with his left arm that affects his driving shot attempt.
Gobert (MIN) pursues the loose ball and the contact with Missi (NOP) is marginal as he secures the rebound.
Alvarado (NOP) maintains a legal guarding position during Conley's (MIN) drive to the basket. Alvarado's arms are in a vertical position as Conley makes the pass.
Murray (NOP) makes clean contact with the ball to steal it away from Edwards (MIN).
Conley (MIN) gathers the ball on his right foot and takes two steps before releasing the pass.
Randle (MIN) establishes positive frontcourt position before receiving the pass.
Williamson (NOP) reaches across Edwards (MIN) for the ball and initiates body contact that affects his driving shot attempt.

DiVincenzo (MIN) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Williamson (NOP).
